headline: Two More Posts in Ruin as the Dead Lands Stir Anew
war_summary: The ledger has shifted since our last edition: it now reads 282 strongpoints to the Colonials, 151 to the Wardens, with three works in ruins — two more than at our last accounting. The Dead Lands, still for the better part of a day, have stirred again, with actions logged at Callahan's Gate and The Salt March right up to bulletin time. Godcrofts, too, has resumed its wrestling about Isawa and Fleecewatch, the latest blow falling as this edition closed. Stlican Shelf, second only to Weathered Expanse in the day's action, counted forty-three episodes with Breaker Town and The Pale House still at their struggle; two of its works lie in ruin. Weathered Expanse tops the sheet at fifty-six actions, though no fresh blow has fallen there since mid-afternoon. Callahan's Passage grinds on, its twenty-four-hour toll near twenty thousand and the hourly rate still climbing, The Latch again the storm-centre. Linn of Mercy shows the map's steepest casualty rate, yet no flag has moved there since mid-morning. Stonecradle's Trammel Pool and Marban Hollow's Mox saw fresh punishment, while Fisherman's Row and the Viper Pit have been quiet for hours. It is day 194; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
